decisions.question: Is closing the dd::argmatch_to_argument goto-reduction gap a small (single Action/Rule) feature or large (proposal-required)?

decider_verdict.reason: Closing the gap requires angr/SAILR ReturnDuplicator-style return-tail duplication: cloning the shared return-tail BlockBasic and its p-code ops, rewiring graph edges, and re-collapsing so each arm folds the duplicated tail into a structured early return while preserving the real v2 Varnode def/use. The verbatim 3635-line s8_structure/blockaction.rs port of CollapseStructure/TraceDAG/BlockTrace has NO schema for duplicating a tail to avoid a goto, so this is a brand-new pass type, not one Action/Rule.
decider_verdict.why_not_small: Cannot be expressed as one Action/Rule like kuna_loweredswitch.rs (which only manufactures an S2 jumptable artifact for the EXISTING structurer). Must mutate the S8 structured block tree (clone + edge-rewire + re-collapse) beyond a single gated early-return, and needs a new S8 module plus block/p-code-clone anchors.
decider_verdict.could_a_peephole_work: No. The shared tail has two predecessors; a duplicate-and-rewire must run before/during S8 collapse to change what TraceDAG sees. A post-emit textual peephole would have to reconstruct structured control flow from emitted C and re-prove def/use equivalence for the live v2 Varnode -- exactly the structural mutation Hard rule 7 forbids in a small change.

decisions.question: Implementation refinement: how to duplicate the return tail without cloning p-code or re-collapsing the verbatim engine's output?
decisions.resolution: The in-loop goto is realized as a BlockIf carrying an if_goto_target (renders `if (cond) goto T`). Rather than clone p-code and re-collapse (the proposal's worst case), ActionGotoReduce runs AFTER ActionFinalStructure and converts that BlockIf in place: it mints fresh BlockCopy leaves over the SAME underlying basic blocks of T's return-tail chain, wraps them as the if's true clause, and drops the goto target. The C printer re-walks each BlockCopy's bblock op list (no per-walk emitted-guard; CPUI_RETURN carries the `returns` flag not `branch`, so it survives the if-body NO_BRANCH), giving a textual duplication that is semantically identical to the goto. No p-code is cloned and SSA/def-use is untouched, collapsing the only-genuine-surgery to one (kuna) block.rs method.
